At some point after [[3522 BBY]], an '''army''' of [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] warriors was assembled by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Desolous]], who had been expelled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for studying [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings. Vowing to exact revenge on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Desolous led his [[Army/Legends|army]] in a [[Darth Desolous conflict|series of ambushes]] on [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], until the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and his warriors were [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Darth Desolous conflict)|crushed]] on [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].

==History==
[[File:DarthDesolousface.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Desolous, the army's founder and leader]]
At some point after [[3522 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and was expelled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for studying [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings. Determined to exact his revenge, he became the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Desolous]] and assembled an [[Army/Legends|army]] of Pau'ans to [[Darth Desolous conflict|fight]] against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Desolous trained the army in his [[Darth Desolous's martial art|personal style of martial arts]], which combined [[Cortosis shield/Legends|cortosis shields]] and melee weapons. Desolous and his men attacked the Jedi throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] almost two thousand [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="TFU databank" />

With each victory, however, Desolous became more reckless and bold, and, when he discovered a small group of Jedi on<ref name="TFU databank" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]], he led his army in a [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Darth Desolous conflict)|direct assault]] there. However, those Jedi merely acted as bait meant to draw Desolous into a trap as a Jedi [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and prevented the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] forces from retreating. The entire Pau'an army was destroyed, and Desolous himself was killed.<ref name="TFU databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pau'an army assembled by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Desolous was mentioned in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]], and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] versions of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''.<ref name="TFU databank" /> These versions were developed by [[Krome Studios]].<ref name="TFU">{{TFU|version=[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]]}}</ref>
